Its largest flank difference sits at 347 µm, while every other run has it at 84 µm (z 6.38). So its curvature-rate profile has a different shape.
Cleared (7): r01, r02, r03, r04, r05, r06, r08. All three checks pass with margin, and their summaries match the batch. r01's REGR-peak z of 2.88 comes from a batch MAD of 0. The real gap is 53.24 against 53.1 %/h, and its peak position and growth-zone length match the batch.
Pattern: only one run was flagged. Its tip motion from the midline and stage log does not match the tip motion from the tracked velocity field, and its flank-difference peak is in the wrong place. Its passed flag for closure does not agree with its own value and threshold, so the pass/fail logic for closure should be checked upstream.
